aggregate_rules: observed_totals and charged_totals are componentwise sums for additive nested paths only
failed_attempt_totals is the componentwise sum of charged vectors for failed child attempts plus the failed supervisor when present
kernel_peak_rss_bytes, sampled_peak_rss_bytes, and peak_live_temporary_allocated_bytes are maxima and never appear in additive totals
wall_makespan_ns is max process_end_ns minus min process_start_ns and is never a componentwise sum
maximum_concurrency uses half-open intervals [start,end): sort ties end before start, then pid; development maximum_concurrency must equal 1
all aggregate arithmetic is checked in unsigned 64-bit range before publication

campaign_limits.scope: campaign aggregate; distinct from every process resource limit

child_failure_vector.work_rule: Every one of the 121 work leaves is exactly 1000000000000 on any failed child, except optimizer nodes_started and optimizer nodes_completed are 2000000, verifier replay_nodes is 2000000, and verifier independent_primary_nodes is 5000000.

counter_vector.representation: nested JSON objects only; dotted keys and flattened leaf names are forbidden
counter_vector.work_leaf_rule: Each work group is a closed object using exactly its ordered leaf list in source-schema-v3.json work_counter_groups, imported by hash. This determines exactly 121 distinct group.leaf paths.

resource_summary_equations: charged_io_bytes = sum charged_counters.io read_bytes, write_bytes, disk_read_bytes, and disk_written_bytes
charged_storage_bytes = max of the seven charged_counters.storage leaves
on success charged_counters equals observed_counters at every leaf

process_limits.scope: root supervisor process only, not child sum or campaign aggregate

supervisor_failure_vector.work_rule: Every one of the 121 work leaves is exactly 1000000000000 on supervisor failure.

authority.transition_rule: Only a later closed Coordinator decision conforming to source-authorization-amendment-v5 may authorize writing source text. Review GO alone changes no authority field.

binding_schema.rule: Every value equals the exact digest in the reviewed design consistency manifest, later Coordinator decision, or post-source consistency manifest. Missing, extra, stale, unequal, or unresolvable bindings are INVALID before semantic work.

canonical_encoding.canonical_json: UTF-8 restricted to ASCII code points, sorted object keys, separators comma and colon, no insignificant whitespace, no floats, no NaN, duplicate keys rejected; file has one terminal LF and value digests exclude that LF

digest_inputs.compiler_packets_sha256: SHA256(canonical JSON array of the 32 compiler packets in compiler_index order)
digest_inputs.input_sha256: SHA256(canonical JSON object containing exact bound upstream IDs and values consumed by that record)
digest_inputs.result_sha256: SHA256(canonical JSON top-level result with result_sha256 key omitted)
digest_inputs.verifier_receipt_sha256: SHA256(canonical JSON complete verifier attempt receipt)

canonical_encoding.histogram: duplicate_collapse_histogram is a list of [multiplicity,count] uint-positive pairs sorted by multiplicity, with unique multiplicities; sum(count)=distinct_flattened_formal_count and sum(multiplicity*count)=flattened_formal_multiset_count
canonical_encoding.maxima: maxima is a lexicographically sorted unique list of formal_degree4 values; retained_maxima_count equals its length
canonical_encoding.ratio: conflict_density is exact object {numerator,denominator}; if eligible_vertex_count<2 it is {0,1}, otherwise numerator=conflict_edge_count, denominator=eligible_vertex_count*(eligible_vertex_count-1)/2, then divided by gcd; booleans rejected

attempt_references: Every completed cell optimizer_attempt_id resolves to exactly one successful optimizer accounting attempt whose cell equals the cell ID.
Every verification verifier_attempt_id resolves to exactly one successful verifier accounting attempt whose cell equals the cell ID and whose canonical receipt digest equals verifier_receipt_sha256.
Every failed_attempt cause resolves to exactly one failed charged accounting attempt whose cell equals the missing cell ID.
Every exhausted_stream cause resolves to exactly one exhausted derivation stream whose dependency closure contains the missing cell ID.
canonical_relations.cell_universe: Exact lexicographic product curve_seed [731001,731002,731003], factor_base_seed [9101,9102,9103], chart_u [1,-1,2,3], compiler_index 0..31, cap_fraction [1/4,1/2,3/4,1]; cap_value is respectively floor(q/4), floor(q/2), floor(3q/4), or q for the accepted curve cardinality q. Exactly 4608 unique IDs.
complete_rules: derivation_streams contains exactly the twelve stream IDs in schedule order, all accepted
fixtures contains exactly all 36 curve/factor/chart identities in lexicographic seed then listed-chart order
cells contains exactly the 4608-cell universe in cell-ID order
every cell status=complete, both referenced attempts succeed, and all fourteen checks are true
all six controls pass and all 65 mutations are rejected
decision and terminal are independently recomputed and equal
decision_rules: classification and qualifying_curve_seeds are recomputed from contract.md ordered decision tree and the complete 4608 cells
decision_input_sha256 hashes the canonical ordered cells, fixtures, controls, and nonvacuity records
top-level terminal classification, decision_tree_version, and reason_codes equal decision values
PASS_PROMOTE is impossible unless every v6 success criterion and nonvacuity gate passes
fixture_relations: curve_stream_id equals curve:<curve_seed> and resolves to the accepted curve stream
factor_stream_id equals factor:<curve_seed>:<factor_base_seed> and resolves to the accepted factor stream
chart_record curve and factor values equal those accepted stream values
fixtures are all and only accepted curve/factor pairs crossed with all four charts
partial_rules: derivation_streams is a nonempty prefix of the twelve-stream schedule; the first stream curve:731001 is always present
a factor stream may start only after its curve stream is accepted
fixtures contains all and only fully accepted curve/factor pairs crossed with all four charts
completed_cells and missing_cells are sorted, unique, disjoint, and partition the 4608-cell universe
each missing cell has one typed cause resolving under attempt_references
zero started streams, orphan causes, uncharged failed causes, and unexplained missing cells are INVALID
decision classification is INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE and equals terminal

control_and_mutation_closure.controls_rule: Exactly one closed control_result per listed ID in order; input_sha256 and expected_sha256 equal the frozen manifest/amendment lookup, passed is literal true, and details_sha256 resolves to retained details. Any failure makes canonical_complete forbidden and terminal INVALID.
control_and_mutation_closure.mutations_rule: Exactly M01 through M65 in order using the five mutation manifests/amendments; each artifact_sha256 resolves, detector equals its manifest, rejected is literal true, and reason_code is the expected closed rejection. Any miss, reorder, false value, or detector mismatch is INVALID.

exhaustion_schema.attempt_rule: attempt_cap is the exact positive integer for kind; attempts are contiguous 0..accepted_attempt or 0..attempt_cap-1; attempt_cap=0 is INVALID
exhaustion_schema.exhausted_seed_rule: kind=curve uses one registered curve seed integer; kind=factor_base uses exact object {curve_seed,factor_base_seed} from registered lists
exhaustion_schema.missing_cause_rule: kind is failed_attempt or exhausted_stream; ref is one nonempty ASCII ID resolving under canonical_relations
exhaustion_schema.terminal_rule: ATTEMPT_CAP_EXHAUSTED occurs only as exhausted stream terminal_reason, never in attempt reasons

rules: all objects use exact V4 key sets except fields superseded here
optimizer full_objective_exact=true, absolute_gap=0, lower_bound=upper_bound, and fresh_state=true
curve_seed and factor_base_seed are exact registered uint values
chart_u is exact int in ordered set [1,-1,2,3]
compiler_index is uint 0..31 and mapping follows canonical_encoding.compiler_mapping
control_index is null for candidate and uint 0..30 for hash_control
cap_value is uint derived by canonical_relations.cell_universe

completed_verification.rule: checks is closed and every value is literal JSON true; IDs and receipt resolve under canonical_relations

missing_cell.rule: id is a canonical cell ID, reason_code is a closed ASCII enum, and cause is a closed missing cause

type_system.affine_point: JSON array [x,y] of exactly two uint values less than p and satisfying the curve; infinity forbidden
type_system.ascii_id: nonempty ASCII string of at most 192 bytes
type_system.bool: exact JSON true or false; integers 0 and 1 rejected
type_system.formal_degree4: JSON array of four nondecreasing uint source labels
type_system.int: exact JSON integer in signed 64-bit range; bool rejected

forbidden_behaviors: any repository-local import other than the verifier file itself
any dynamic import, importlib loader, runpy, eval, exec, compile, ctypes, cffi, dlopen, subprocess, os.system, or shell invocation
any read outside the declared result, immutable normative artifacts, and verifier-owned temporary path
any producer, optimizer, prior SGCP output, precomputed representative table, or undeclared cache read
any source-text overlap of a normalized function body with producer or worker other than trivial one-line wrappers
verifier_independence.independence_rule: The auditor is a separate standard-library-only program. It resolves every imported module origin against sysconfig standard-library roots, records the runtime loaded-module closure, AST-calls, opened paths, normalized function hashes, and forbidden matches. It does not import or execute the verifier. Any forbidden behavior is INVALID.
verifier_independence.receipt_rule: Retained path verifier-independence-audit.json; receipt_sha256 hashes the canonical receipt with that key omitted; passed is literal true; forbidden_findings is empty and forbidden_reference_count=0; top-level payload embeds the byte-identical receipt.
